summary:
Round 9, engineer "klein": started 05:30, last source change 06:23, finished about 06:41 (71 minutes). Final page dist/r9-klein.html builds from base8 plus my three files; tools/smoke.json passes on it (52 steps, exit 0, no console errors); all 67 pictures of the lists that must not change are identical to dist/v8.html (largest channel difference 0).

kleinian-1 is PARTLY cured, and not by the cure the assignment describes. I built that cure as written first (trap tested at the point and at its images under the slides and the half turn, nearest wins, touch record in step) and judged it by pictures: it fills the stage with huge balls on every entry, hides the lace of entries 0 and 21, and gives a black stage for entry 0 with the trap at x = 0.6 (measured, t1-pairs-a.png). Limited to the slides alone it leaves entries 0 and 21 as they were and makes entries 3 and 24 worse (measured, vA-vB-pairs.png). Reasoned why: the search's own map carries the half-turned copy of the radius 1 shell exactly onto the shell, so with the half turn among the images the trap shape itself is back in the solid one step after the start, whatever the skip dial says.

What I found and fixed instead: the "very large sheets that run out of the picture" and the fan of spikes are the trap shape itself coming into the solid two steps late. The search ends in a cycle of two points, so for a point already at rest step 2 is the starting point again, half turned or slid; the skip dial only left out step 0. In a group that leans the half-turned shell reaches under the wavy dividing line and that part appeared as a huge piece cut off along the edges of the copy. Now a step that only comes back to a skipped step is skipped too (kde in 30-shaders.js), and the search keeps the touch record itself so colours never come from a step that is not in the solid. Measured on 47 Kleinian scenes: the sheets are gone on entries 3, 24 and 33, on entry 0 with x = 0.6, and for planes and ring on entry 3, at Balanced and Fine and zoomed out; entry 0, entry 21 and the three Kleinian examples look as before less a stray thin disc.

Still wrong (measured, two crops at full size): on leaning groups one to three balls a scene are still cut open with a flat or jagged face, and a smaller fringe of stripes remains on entry 3. The note beside the choice is therefore still true and unchanged; no text on the page changed.

Item 3 (40-render.js) is done and measured: no other formulas are prepared while a picture or model job runs (0 programs started during the job against 12 to 13 on v8), and idle() is false while the graphics are lost in the middle of a picture (v8 true). The time saved by the first did not show in my runs on the shared GPU.

Not started: solids-5, words-5, words-4 (their reference pictures exist and are identical on the final page). Notes: notes/r9-klein.md.

fixed.what: In the Kleinian search (kde, 30-shaders.js) a step that only comes back to a step that was skipped is skipped as well. Before, a point already at rest was tested at step 2 against the trap shape itself in its half-turned or slid copy, which the skip dial is there to leave out; in a leaning group that part showed as huge pieces cut off along the edges of the copy. The trap test moved to the start of a turn (same point, z0) and the search keeps the touch record for the colours itself; the colour module's record is compiled out of the Kleinian program. The balls that are still cut open are listed under not_fixed.

not_fixed.why: The cure the assignment describes was built and judged and cannot be shipped: with the half turn among the trap's images it fills the stage with huge balls (out/r9/klein/t1-pairs-a.png, t1-pairs-b.png; code out/r9/klein/var/30-D-turn-next.js), and with the slides alone it makes entries 3 and 24 worse (vA-vB-pairs.png; var/30-A-slide-next.js, 30-B-slide.js). After the fix above, one to three balls a scene are still cut open with a flat or jagged face and a smaller fringe of stripes remains on entry 3 (crop-k01-e03-is.png, crop-k02-e24-is.png). The note beside the choice still says so and is unchanged.
not_fixed.learned: MEASURED: the three variants above. REASONED: (1) the search's map carries the half-turned radius 1 shell onto the shell itself, so any trap made symmetric under the half turn brings the trap shape back one step after the start; (2) the worse pictures of the slide-only variants were very likely the same late return of the trap shape, multiplied by the copies, so those variants should be judged again on top of the new rule; (3) a plane model (out/r9/klein/model.py, model/sheet-e03.png) shows whole circles when the trap and its images are tested together with the map applied to the neighbours across each edge, so the idea is sound for the pattern. Next thing to try: keep the new rule and add the map applied to the neighbours across each edge, tested against the one trap (no images), with the same return rule for the neighbour's step.

risks: kleinian-1 is still open: balls cut open remain on leaning groups and off-centre traps. I judged the change on sheets at 0.3 to 0.42 of full size and two crops at full size, in one pass, on 47 scenes; only the sphere shell was looked at closely.

Every Kleinian trap solid changed a little, the three examples included (3.6 to 8.8 percent of their pixels; to the eye a thin stray disc gone). No Kleinian trap solid picture is identical to Version 8.

With 2 or more steps skipped a Kleinian trap solid is now much sparser than in Version 8 (entry 3 at skip 3 is scattered fragments). It matches the help text, but nobody has judged whether users like it.

In 'Is added to the solid', the query a pearl's colour is read from ends at the landing step before that step's point is tested against the trap (it used to be tested). Reasoned to matter only where a pearl's surface lies inside a trap piece; not seen in the pictures, not tested on its own.
A 3D model of a Kleinian trap solid uses the same search and was not made or compared with its picture.

The opening Mandelbrot drawing time failed the 'within a quarter of base4' rule in the one run that had base4 in it (1252 against 766 ms, GPU shared with ten others); the second run and the reasoning say it is load, but it is not shown on a quiet GPU. Mandelbrot compile time met its limit by 44 ms in that run.

The time a picture job saves by not preparing formulas was not shown by my runs. While a job runs, a program that was already being prepared stays in R.warming until the job ends (harmless as far as I can reason; not tested with a model job, only a picture job).

idle() now stays false for as long as the graphics stay away after being lost in the middle of a picture. A test that loses the context mid-picture and never restores it will wait for idle() until its timeout.
The cause given for the worse pictures of the slide-only variants is reasoned, not tested.
